# Inside Leads — AI Crawler Reference

> Inside Leads (getinsideleads.com) is a performance-driven digital marketing and AI consulting agency founded by John Kornegay. We serve local businesses in Raleigh-Durham-Chapel Hill, NC and Detroit, MI.

## About

Inside Leads helps owner-operated small businesses grow their local presence and generate leads through search marketing, paid advertising, and AI-powered strategy. Founded by John Kornegay, a digital marketing professional with 20+ years of experience and a Certified Scrum Master.

## Services

- SEO Strategy — on-page, technical, and content optimization for organic search growth
- PPC Advertising — Google Ads and paid search campaign management focused on ROI
- Local SEO — Google Business Profile optimization and hyperlocal search visibility
- Social Media Management — platform strategy, content, and community management
- Web Development — performance-focused websites built for conversion
- AI Consulting — AI strategy, tool integration, and workflow automation for small businesses

## Markets Served

- Raleigh, Cary, Durham, Chapel Hill (North Carolina)
- Detroit, Dearborn, Farmington Hills, Southfield (Michigan)
